title: Vasaloppet Aerobic Base Building - Low Back Friendly Endurance Session

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and controlled. Focus on gentle spinal articulation without forcing extension. Prioritize mobility over range of motion given mild back soreness.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Alternate sides slowly. Keep core engaged and neutral spine. This activates stabilizer muscles while being low-impact on the back.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the movement through hips. Engage core throughout. Excellent for hip mobility without spinal stress.

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Rock gently back onto heels, feeling stretch in inner thighs. Maintain neutral spine. Prepares legs for endurance work.

items.name: Air Bike
items.cues: Easy, steady pace. RPE 2-3. Gradually increase heart rate. Focus on smooth pedal strokes to prepare cardiovascular system.

items.name: Air Bike Steady State
items.cues: Maintain RPE 5-6 (conversational pace). Keep cadence steady around 85-95 RPM. This is your aerobic base builder for Vasaloppet. Focus on consistency over intensity. Monitor posture—sit upright to minimize back stress. Break into 10-minute blocks mentally: Block 1 (min 0-10) establish rhythm, Block 2 (min 10-20) settle into effort, Block 3 (min 20-30) maintain steady push, Block 4 (min 30-40) focus on form and breathing, Block 5 (min 40-50) strong finish at same effort level.

items.name: Air Bike Active Recovery
items.cues: Decrease intensity gradually. RPE 2-3. Light spinning to flush metabolic byproducts and begin recovery.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Gentle spinal mobility. Move slowly and mindfully. Promotes blood flow to fatigued muscles and helps reduce back tension.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each side 20-30 seconds. Lean into stretch. Counteracts calf tightness from cycling/running training.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Hold each arm 20-30 seconds against wall. Releases upper body tension accumulated during long endurance effort.

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Gentle rocking motion. Hold stretch at end range for 2 seconds per rep. Addresses leg tightness from endurance work.

rationale: This endurance session builds aerobic base for Vasaloppet 90km race. 50 minutes of steady-state cycling at RPE 5-6 develops aerobic capacity without excessive intensity, appropriate for 51 days before event.

Given mild back soreness (3/5), the workout avoids high-impact activities and uses Air Bike as primary tool—excellent for Vasaloppet-specific conditioning while minimizing spinal loading. Warmup and cooldown include mobility work to manage back discomfort.

3-day gap since last session and current soreness status warrant starting slightly easier with thorough mobility activation. The 70-minute total duration includes progressive warmup and recovery-focused cooldown, ensuring adequate work capacity development while respecting current recovery status.
